is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (Abstract, Page 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper explicitly states in the Discussion (Page 5) that 'the study did not evaluate the specific resistance mechanisms, such as metabolic resistance, target-site mutations, or behavioral avoidance'.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype counts or frequencies for resistance markers are reported; the study only provides phenotypic mortality data from CDC bottle bioassays.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquito larvae were collected in June 2024 from Zuba, FCT, Nigeria (Page 2, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study reporting new bioassay data from field-collected mosquitoes.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data are tied to Zuba (latitude 9.1023, longitude 7.1952) in the Gwagwalada Area Council of Abuja, Nigeria (Page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The authors state this is the first phenotypic assessment of pyrethroid susceptibility in the An. gambiae s.l. population in Zuba (Page 5).

supplement.evidence: The supplementary materials mentioned (Supplementary Material 1 and 2) are included in the main text on pages 2 and 3 and contain only insecticide dilution protocols, not genotype data.

assessment.summary: This study reports phenotypic resistance to permethrin and deltamethrin in field-collected Anopheles gambiae s.l. from Zuba, Nigeria, using CDC bottle bioassays. However, it does not perform any molecular genotyping of insecticide-resistance markers and explicitly notes this as a limitation.
exclusion_reasons: Does not report any of the target insecticide-resistance markers.
Does not report extractable genotype data.
